headline: EPS swings to a profit year-over-year but falls sequentially
summary_short: NC reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩6,407, down 16.5% q/q from ₩7,672 but swinging from a ₩1,826 per-share loss a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ₩6,407 fell 16.5% sequentially from ₩7,672 but swung from a ₩1,826 per-share loss in the year-ago quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
